rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy maintains liability insurance (toiminnan vastuuvakuutus) with cover of EUR 2,000,000, which exceeds the minimum threshold required in clause 3.1.
Visakoivu Oy holds Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, which satisfies the minimum requirement of class S2.

Visakoivu Oy has multiple equivalent reference projects completed within the last five years, including a EUR 1,650,000 property and LVI maintenance framework for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (2021-2024). Two further comparable projects within the same period -- a property maintenance annual contract for Tuomisto Oy (2024) and an LVI maintenance outsourcing contract for Kelohonka Logistiikka Oy covering three properties (2024-2025) -- bring the total to at least three references within the required five-year window.
Visakoivu Oy's revenue in the 2025 financial year was EUR 20,300,000, well above the required minimum.

Condition-monitoring data is collected and evaluated by Visakoivu Oy's rakennusautomaatio team (18 specialists), who maintain building automation and monitoring systems across client properties as part of routine maintenance.

Visakoivu Oy employs around 180 staff across its technical disciplines, allowing more than one qualified person to be assigned to each account so that service continues without interruption if an individual team member leaves or changes role.
Waste generated during maintenance and installation work is sorted on site according to material type and removed by Visakoivu Oy in line with the applicable municipal waste-sorting requirements.

On handover, Visakoivu Oy will deliver an up-to-date asset register and supporting documentation for the shopping centre's building systems, in a format agreed with centre management, and will keep the register current for the duration of the contract.

Visakoivu Oy provides a warranty on installed equipment and materials in line with standard industry practice and the relevant manufacturer terms, with the applicable warranty period confirmed per item at project sign-off.

Periodic statutory inspections of electrical installations are carried out by personnel operating under Visakoivu Oy's Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, with inspection records kept and made available to centre management.

Site personnel operate under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety system and hold the qualifications required for their trade, including LUSA-patevyys and Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, for electrical work.
Visakoivu Oy maintains stock of common spare and wear parts and sources non-stocked parts through established supplier relationships, with delivery times confirmed per item at the time of order.

Maintenance visits are scheduled with centre management in advance and cover a defined checklist per building system, timed where practicable outside the centre's peak trading hours to minimise disruption.

Section 4.10 of this request states a maximum fault response time of 4 hours from notification, while Liite B clause 1.1 states that the technical specification sets the response time at 2 hours. Visakoivu Oy flags this discrepancy for clarification and, pending confirmation from Kauppakeskus Solmu Oy, will commit to the shorter 2-hour response time as the more demanding of the two stated figures.
Visakoivu Oy accepts the three-year initial contract period and is prepared to discuss any extension exercised at Kauppakeskus Solmu Oy's discretion on the same terms as the initial period.
Visakoivu Oy will invoice monthly in arrears, itemised by work order, in the format required by Kauppakeskus Solmu Oy's accounts function.
Visakoivu Oy will provide a full cost breakdown by service line, in the format requested by Kauppakeskus Solmu Oy.
Visakoivu Oy will price this contract using a fixed monthly maintenance fee for routine works, supplemented by time-and-materials rates for additional call-outs, itemised as required in clause 5.3.
A current kaupparekisteriote for Visakoivu Oy (business ID 1876543-2) is enclosed with this quotation.
A current certificate of tax payment for Visakoivu Oy is enclosed with this quotation.
This quotation is provided as a single PDF file with no password protection.
Prices in this quotation are stated as euro per square metre per year, not euro per month, as required.
This tender document, excluding attachments, does not exceed 20 pages, as required.
The reference currency for all pricing in this quotation is euro.
Building envelope condition is assessed during scheduled property inspections, with defects and deterioration logged and fed into the preventive maintenance plan for the centre.

Centre management receives regular written maintenance reports covering completed and outstanding work orders, condition findings and any recommended remedial work, on a schedule agreed with Kauppakeskus Solmu Oy.

Visakoivu Oy operates an occupational safety plan under its NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety system, covering site risk assessment, permit-to-work procedures and incident reporting for all work carried out at the shopping centre.

Elevator servicing is arranged through an accredited elevator-maintenance subcontractor under Visakoivu Oy's subcontractor management framework, with Visakoivu Oy remaining responsible for ensuring the work meets applicable elevator safety regulations and for reporting the results to centre management.

Liite B clause 1.1 states that the technical specification sets the fault response time at 2 hours, while Section 4.10 of the body states a maximum of 4 hours from notification. Visakoivu Oy flags this discrepancy for clarification and, pending confirmation from Kauppakeskus Solmu Oy, will commit to the shorter 2-hour response time as the more demanding of the two stated figures.
Visakoivu Oy will offer a volume-based discount structure against annual call-off value, with tiers and rates to be agreed with Kauppakeskus Solmu Oy during contract finalisation.
An insurance certificate confirming Visakoivu Oy's liability insurance cover of EUR 2,000,000 is enclosed with this quotation.
CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract, covering the relevant LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito disciplines, are enclosed with this quotation.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this quotation for technical property maintenance services at Kauppakeskus Solmu, reference SOLMU-RFQ-2026-14. We have read the request in full, including both annexes, and have addressed every point raised, including one discrepancy we noticed between the body and an annex over the fault response time, flagged at clause 4.10.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, founded in 1994, with around 180 employees working across LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito. The company holds NMSB 7310, NMSB 74210 and NMSB 75310 certification, LUSA-patevyys and Sahkourakointioikeudet, and has delivered multiple property and technical maintenance contracts for private and public clients across Keski-Suomi.
